title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Model Council in Researcher runs Anthropic and OpenAI models side by side
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, provider controls, Researcher block and licensing statements are supported. Two minor corrections would clarify that Learn already mentions Council in an announcement and that the blocking API is beta and unsupported for production applications.

claims.claim: Council runs models from different providers in parallel for comparison of consensus and conflict.
claims.quote: Council in Researcher runs multiple leading AI models from different providers in parallel in one place, so you can quickly compare outputs and see consensus vs. conflict)

claims.quote: Searched: Researcher Council model data distribution permissions judge OpenAI. Opened Council blog, Researcher FAQ, OpenAI subprocessor and May announcements; none identifies the operator of Council's OpenAI model.

claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Frontier enrollment Turn on Frontier Microsoft Graph API PowerShell tenant configuration management frontier resource. Opened Frontier enrolment and TCM Copilot reference; TCM describes an OCPS tenant policy, not user enrolment assignments.

claims.claim: The tenant Researcher block is reached at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... select an agent from the list of agents. ... immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.

claims.claim: The Edit users panel is disabled for Researcher.
